hero.meta_title: Sotto — People Notes App to Remember Details About People
hero.meta_description: Sotto is a private people notes app for iPhone and Android: remember sizes, birthdays, allergies and gift ideas for the people you love.
hero.tagline: Gentle people notes for the details that matter
hero.description: Everyone carries little details worth remembering. Sotto keeps them safe for you — heights, preferences, the things only you would know. All data stays on your phone, quietly helping you remember.
hero.proof: Rated {{average}} on the App Store in Taiwan · {{n}} ratings
hero.assurance: Free to start · No account · One-time purchase, no subscription

features.title: Designed for the People You Care About
features.subtitle: Simple, gentle, and yours alone

prompts.title: A Question to Open With
prompts.desc: Stuck for what to ask? Pick one from a curated catalog — a fresh note opens prefilled with the question, ready for their answer.
prompts.credits: Question catalog informed by Aron's 36 Questions (1997), Gottman's Love Maps, NYT's 13 Questions, Gary Chapman's The 5 Love Languages (1992), and the curation shared by Threads user hey.roseline.

profiles.title: A Page for Every Person
profiles.desc: Create a little world for each person you care about — photos, bios, and the details that make them who they are.

measurements.title: Never Guess a Size
measurements.desc: Height, shoe size, a ring size for every finger — 23 size and measurement fields, so you never have to secretly ask before buying a gift. Ring sizes convert between seven systems, shoe sizes between five.

themes.title: The Look You Love
themes.desc: 8 carefully crafted color themes, light and dark, so every screen feels like yours.

privacy.title: These Are Your Secrets
privacy.desc: Everything stays on your phone — no account, no ads. Lock the app with your phone's own screen lock (Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint or passcode), and back up only to your own cloud, only when you choose.

notes.title: Write Down What Matters
notes.desc: Their favorite coffee, her anniversary, something they once said — jot it down so you never forget.

tagline.text: For the people you love, every little thing matters. The birthday before it sneaks up. The size when you're picking a gift. The little truths, kept private.

reviews.title: In their own words
reviews.subtitle: Real reviews from people who use Sotto, and what we built after reading them.
reviews.source: Ratings and reviews from the App Store in Taiwan, October 2026. Reviews translated from Traditional Chinese.

uu14188.title: Highly recommend!
uu14188.body: Sometimes it's just a cute little thing, but once it's written down, I'm happy every time I open the app and see it, and I get to relive the memory. Love it~

moyu.title: Please add photos to notes
moyu.body: I'd love to use this app to keep the little moments with friends and family. Being able to upload photos from each get-together would make it even better.
moyu.response: Hi! The latest version lets you add photos, videos and files to notes. Give it a try. Thank you so much for the suggestion ^^
moyu.shipped: photos, videos and files in notes.

diadialydia.title: Feature request~~
diadialydia.body: If we could add friends, connect, and send each other questions we'd like the other person to answer (like "What memory of us do you remember most?" or "When do you feel loved by me?"), this would be an incredibly powerful app!
diadialydia.response: We didn't want a day to come when server costs forced this feature, or the whole app, to shut down (and we don't want to charge a subscription), so we built a question catalog instead: pick one and talk it through together. Sitting face to face over a coffee or a drink, you feel each other's thoughts better than answering in an app. Hope you like it

dreamer.title: Recommended by a friend
dreamer.body: Great app. I often visit different clients, and it's perfect for keeping notes on them. Could you add images and sharing in the future?
dreamer.response: Got it. We'll think about how to add these features.
dreamer.shipped: photos in notes, and sharing a person's page as an image.

closing.title: Start with one person
closing.text: Sotto is free for up to 5 people, with up to 10 fields and 5 notes each. When you need more, one purchase removes the limits for good. No subscription.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ALU Studio ("we", "our", or "us") developed Sotto (the "App"). This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our App. We believe privacy is a fundamental right, and Sotto is designed from the ground up to protect yours.

local_storage.title: How Your Data Is Stored
local_storage.desc: Sotto stores all of your data locally on your device. We do not upload your data to any server. Information you enter in the App includes:
items: Body measurements (height, weight, chest, waist, etc.)
App preferences and settings (themes, units, etc.)

no_collection.title: Information We Do Not Collect
no_collection.desc: Sotto does not collect, transmit, or share any of your personal content. Specifically, we do not:
items: Share your personal content (contacts, measurements, notes) with any third party
Use cookies or any tracking technologies

biometric.title: Biometric Authentication
biometric.desc: Sotto offers an optional App Lock feature using Face ID or Touch ID. Biometric data is handled entirely by Apple's LocalAuthentication framework and is stored in the secure enclave on your device. We cannot access, collect, or store any biometric data.

icloud.title: iCloud Backup
icloud.desc: If you have iCloud Backup enabled, data on your device may be included in Apple's iCloud backups. This is governed by Apple's privacy policy, not our App. You can manage this in your device's iCloud settings.

analytics.title: Analytics & Crash Reporting
analytics.desc: Sotto uses Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics, provided by Google, to help us understand how the App is used and to identify and fix crashes. These services collect:
items: Anonymous usage data (e.g., which features are used, session duration)
Crash reports (e.g., stack traces, device model, OS version)
Device information (e.g., device type, operating system, app version)
A randomly generated instance identifier (not linked to your identity)
analytics.note: This data is anonymous and does not include any personal content you enter in the App (such as contacts, measurements, or notes). For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

data_deletion.title: Data Deletion
data_deletion.intro: All personal data in Sotto — contact profiles, measurements, notes, custom fields, settings, and OAuth tokens — is stored only on your device. Our servers never receive this data.
data_deletion.how_desc: Uninstall Sotto, or use “Clear app data” in your device’s system settings. This action is irreversible.
data_deletion.analytics_title: Anonymous statistics collected by Firebase Analytics
data_deletion.analytics_desc: The install ID is an anonymous identifier randomly generated for each installation. It is not linked to your Google account or any personal information. Uninstalling the app invalidates this ID, and a new installation generates a new one. Previously recorded events are automatically deleted by Google after 14 months.
data_deletion.backup_title: Cloud backup files (if you enabled backup)
data_deletion.backup_desc: Backup files are stored in your own Google Drive or Dropbox account. To delete them, remove the files directly in that service.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.desc: Sotto integrates Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics by Google solely for anonymous usage analytics and crash reporting. No other third-party services are used. All core features of the App work without an internet connection.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.desc: Sotto does not collect personal information from children. The anonymous analytics data collected by Firebase does not identify individual users of any age.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.desc: If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you through an App update. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.desc: If you have any questions or suggestions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

faq.meta_title: Sotto FAQ — Questions About the People Notes App
faq.meta_description: Answers to common questions about Sotto: what it does, pricing, accounts, reminders, and privacy.
faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Questions about Sotto? Here are answers to the ones people ask most.
faq.contact_prompt: Didn't find what you were looking for? Reach out to us:

what_is_sotto.title: What is Sotto?
what_is_sotto.answer: Sotto is an app that helps you remember the small but important details about the people you love — their height, preferences, a favorite coffee order, an anniversary, or something they once said. Every person gets their own private page combining a photo and bio, personal notes, body measurements, and guided conversation questions.
bullets: A page for every person you care about
Personal notes for the little things they say or like
23 size and measurement fields (height, shoe size, ring size and more) with unit conversion
A catalog of 323 questions to open new conversations

who_is_sotto_for.title: Who is Sotto for?
who_is_sotto_for.answer: Sotto is for anyone who wants a private, judgment-free place to remember details about the people they care about — partners, family, close friends, or anyone whose preferences and stories are easy to lose track of. Think of it as a personal CRM for the people you love rather than for sales or networking: simple and gentle, not a full contacts database.

is_sotto_free.title: Is Sotto free?
is_sotto_free.answer: Sotto is free to download, and the free version includes every feature for up to 5 people, with up to 10 fields and 5 notes per person. A single one-time purchase removes those limits for good — there is no subscription.

do_i_need_an_account.title: Do I need to create an account to use Sotto?
do_i_need_an_account.answer: No — Sotto requires no sign-up and no login, and all core features work without an internet connection. Everything you enter is stored locally on your device. If you choose to use the optional backup, you connect your own iCloud (iPhone only), Google Drive or Dropbox account, and the backup file lands in storage you control.

what_can_i_record.title: What kind of information can I record in Sotto?
what_can_i_record.answer: For each person's page, Sotto lets you save a photo and bio, personal notes, and any of 130 built-in fields — from birthdays and allergies to favorite food and gift ideas — plus fields you create yourself. 23 of them cover sizes and measurements, like height, shoe size and a ring size for every finger, with unit conversion, so you never have to secretly ask someone's size before buying a gift.
bullets: Personal notes (favorite coffee, an anniversary, a quote they said)
23 size and measurement fields with unit conversion
Dates such as birthdays and anniversaries, with optional reminders

does_sotto_send_reminders.title: Can Sotto remind me of birthdays and anniversaries?
does_sotto_send_reminders.answer: Yes — turn on a reminder for any date field, such as a birthday or an anniversary, and Sotto notifies you 7 days before, at 9:00 in the morning, every year. Reminders are set per person and per date, so you only hear about the dates you chose. A date whose year you don't know still works: Sotto keeps the month and day for the reminder.

does_sotto_suggest_questions.title: Does Sotto suggest questions to ask the people I care about?
does_sotto_suggest_questions.answer: Yes — Sotto includes a catalog of 323 conversation-starter questions. Pick one when you're not sure what to ask, and it opens a fresh note prefilled with that question, ready for their answer.
bullets: A curation shared by Threads user hey.roseline

is_my_data_private.title: Is my data in Sotto private? Does it get uploaded anywhere?
is_my_data_private.answer: Yes — Sotto stores all of your data locally on your device and never uploads it to Alu Studio's servers. The app does not collect personally identifiable information, track your location, use advertising SDKs, or share your content with any third party. The only time your data leaves your device is when you explicitly run the optional backup to your own cloud storage.
bullets: Optional App Lock that uses your phone's own screen lock — Face ID, Touch ID or passcode on iPhone; fingerprint, face, PIN, pattern or password on Android
Firebase Analytics collects anonymous usage data, and on iPhone Firebase Crashlytics collects crash reports — never your personal content
Optional backup goes to your own iCloud (iPhone only), Google Drive or Dropbox — storage you control, not Alu Studio's servers
Uninstalling the app erases all on-device data permanently

what_platforms_is_sotto_on.title: What platforms is Sotto available on?
what_platforms_is_sotto_on.answer: Sotto is available on iPhone (iOS 17 or later) and Android (Android 9 or later), free on the App Store and Google Play, in 12 languages. Your data stays on the device you use it on.
